title: His brother, stepbrothers and sisters
summary: He talks about his only brother, a riverfront worker, and a stepbrother who is a mechanic.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: How many brothers and sisters did you have?

I got one brother can't whistle. Don't know how to whistle. Never, don't know no nothing but a river front. Why he works? He works out of the river front. Get out of the river front. Don't know no other ways but a river front. Been out there 26 years.
Is that your only brother or do you have?
I got step brothers and sisters.
I got a step brother. He's a game number one mechanic. But he won't fix my car.
Is he musically inclined in any way?
